challenge_title: One place for the whole day
challenge:
Tasks live in one app, notes in another, health and learning in a third, and none of them talk to each other. The result is constant switching and nothing that sees the whole picture.

We built a single system from scratch that tracks tasks, plans, goals, health, learning and the rest of daily life, and talks to the user where they already are: in Telegram.
built_intro: A backend, a web app and an AI assistant on one knowledge base.

built.title: Today, upcoming and goals
built.text: A web app with a daily view, upcoming items, all tasks, projects, goals and areas of life.

built.title: Health and learning
built.text: Health tracking with Apple Health, and a learning area for language study.

built.title: An AI assistant in Telegram
built.text: A bot that briefs the user in the morning, reviews the evening and the week, nudges goals and sends reminders.

built.title: A connected knowledge graph
built.text: An Obsidian vault configured across platforms, so notes, tasks and goals form one connected graph.

built.title: Cost control
built.text: Daily and monthly limits on the AI budget: the bot refuses model calls past the cap.

built.title: Your own data
built.text: Everything is stored in plain files the user owns, not in a closed app.

ai_title: An assistant that comes to you
ai_text: The assistant reads the user’s tasks, plans and notes and turns them into a short briefing, the next tasks and timely reminders. It works with the user’s own data, inside a spending cap, and the user stays in charge of what is planned and done.
